'f_fdd6d2d2f4a4d2f5b908fb', 'ZM3D release calendar — Q4', 'arthur.blake@harmonygames.co', '["leonard.hayes@harmonygames.co","frederick.stone@harmonygames.co","robert@harmonygames.co","claire.morgan@harmonygames.co","martin.walsh@harmonygames.co","marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co"]', 'private', 'Zombie Match 3D store submissions, Q4 2025. Owner: Arthur.
Oct 17 submission: the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut is Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Anything that ships in the build has to be merged by then. Submit Fri Oct 17.
iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so new iOS screenshots go up with the Oct 17 submission and are due by the same Oct 16 12:00 PT cut.
Apple review has been taking up to 3 days, so plan on that build and its iOS store listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day and allow 1 day for review.
Nov 6 submission: post-Halloween clean-up (icon and screenshots back to normal).

sources.quote:
'Seasonal dressing goes on top of the current art only. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the zombie swap with the new background, Jul 29) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture is the one that counts.
A video whose master has the music baked in is re-cut first from a master without music (re-export one from the project if there is none), so the seasonal pass can be edited.', NULL, 0, 1000000, 9144000, 4143500, NULL, NULL

OE 1  Find #zombie_marketing in Slack and read Leonard's message of yesterday (channel search with private channels included, since the channel is private, then read the channel)
Expected: Leonard Hayes, Tue Sep 30 2025 3:05 PM PT, tagging Claire: "go through everything that's live today and work out what gets a halloween version, what needs work first, what we already have, and who makes what by when".
